Some discoveries are so unsettling, they leave more questions than answers. In Expedition X, Jessica Chobot and Phil Torres investigate reports of mysterious creatures, paranormal encounters and unexplained phenomena in places where the unknown seems closer than ever.
Watch Expedition X, Season 4, Episodes 10, 11, 16, 13, 1, 7, 16, 12, 9 & 15 on Discovery Channel India.
